ArgonTest.Name: Write file
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _
import Argon.Core::* import Argon.IO::*
proc main(): () do let path = Path.from_string "output.bin" let data = Array.newFilled 4 0u8 data[0] := 10u8 data[1] := 20u8 data[2] := 30u8 data[3] := 40u8
let output_resource = path.open_write if data.length >= 4 then output_resource.resource.write data 1 2 end output_resource.close ()
let input_path = Path.from_string "output.bin" let input_resource = input_path.open_read let result_data = Array.newFilled 4 99u8 if result_data.length >= 4 then let read_count = input_resource.resource.read result_data 0 4 puts (read_count.to_s()) puts (result_data[0].to_s()) puts (result_data[1].to_s()) puts (result_data[2].to_s()) let eof_count = input_resource.resource.read result_data 0 1 puts (eof_count.to_s()) end input_resource.close () end
